pages.title: Executive Defect Health
pages.purpose: Leadership summary of backlog, risk, and trend direction
pages.layout: Top KPI row, large trend visual, right-side risk summary
pages.acceptance_criteria: Page should answer: how large is the backlog, how much is open, and what is the trend.

pages.title: Backlog and SLA Risk
pages.purpose: Reveal risk concentration by priority, SLA breach, and customer impact
pages.layout: Two risk charts and one matrix or table
pages.acceptance_criteria: Page should highlight the highest-risk issues and populations needing intervention.

pages.title: Trend and Mix
pages.purpose: Show defect creation patterns and issue mix by priority and area
pages.layout: Line chart plus stacked or grouped mix chart
pages.acceptance_criteria: Page should show whether trend and mix are stable or deteriorating over time.

pages.title: Defect Detail
pages.acceptance_criteria: Page should support operational drill-through without overwhelming the executive audience.
